hints: Lighter blue means less blue dye has diffused out in 5 minutes, so look closely at what controls how fast dye leaves each agar block: total surface area exposed to water and temperature.
Compare each option to the first experiment (1.0 x 1.0 x 1.0 cm, volume = 1.0 cm3, surface area = 6.0 cm2, at 20 C) by working out total volume of dye available and total surface area for diffusion.
walkthrough:
**Recall what makes the water bluer**

Think like the dye molecule. To colour the water, it must diffuse out of the agar across the surface.

More total surface area means faster loss, higher temperature means faster kinetic energy and faster diffusion, and more total agar volume means more dye available. Lighter blue means slower or less diffusion overall.

**Calculate the starting point**

For the first experiment, one block of $1.0 \text{ cm} \times 1.0 \text{ cm} \times 1.0 \text{ cm}$:

Total volume = $$1.0 \times 1.0 \times 1.0 = 1.0 \text{ cm}^3$$

Total surface area = $$6 \times (1.0 \times 1.0) = 6.0 \text{ cm}^2$$

Temperature = $20^{\circ}\text{C}$. Any experiment with much less surface area, less total volume, and no increase in temperature will be lighter.

**Test option B against the start**

For B, each small block is $0.5 \text{ cm} \times 0.5 \text{ cm} \times 0.5 \text{ cm}$ and there are 2 blocks at $20^{\circ}\text{C}$:

Total volume = $$2 \times (0.5 \times 0.5 \times 0.5) = 0.25 \text{ cm}^3$$

Total surface area = $$2 \times 6 \times (0.5 \times 0.5) = 3.0 \text{ cm}^2$$

Both total dye and total surface area are much smaller than the first experiment, with the same temperature, so less dye diffuses out in 5 minutes. That gives a lighter blue, so B is the answer.

options.A: Gives a darker blue. Total volume is the same (1.0 cm3) but total surface area is 12.0 cm2 and temperature is higher at 30 C, so diffusion is much faster.
options.B: Gives a lighter blue. Total volume is only 0.25 cm3 and total surface area is only 3.0 cm2 at the same 20 C, so much less dye can diffuse out.
options.C: Gives a darker blue. Total volume is the same (1.0 cm3) but total surface area is 8.0 cm2 and temperature is higher at 30 C, so diffusion is faster.
options.D: Gives a darker blue. Total volume is larger (2.0 cm3) and total surface area is larger (10.0 cm2) at the same temperature, so more dye diffuses out.
